item.title: Zelenskyy proposes fresh peace talks with Russia next week; urges ceasefire push
item.description: President Zelenskyy announced Ukraine's proposal for renewed peace talks with Russia next week, aiming to revive ceasefire efforts after previous negotiations stalled. Umerov, the National Security and Defence Council Secretary, has been tasked with leading the new discussions. This proposal comes amidst ongoing conflict and pressure from the U.S., with Trump issuing a 50-day deadline for a peace agreement or face economic repercussions.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: GTA V finally launches in Saudi Arabia and UAE after 12 years since release: Is the game censored?
item.description: After nearly 12 years of waiting, Grand Theft Auto V and GTA Online are officially launching in Saudi Arabia and the UAE under a newly introduced 21+ age rating. This historic release signals a major shift in the region’s acceptance of mature gaming content and lays the groundwork for the highly anticipated GTA VI release in 2026.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Prince Al-Waleed, Saudi Arabia’s ‘Sleeping Prince,’ passes away: What left him in a 20-year coma?
item.description: Prince Al-Waleed bin Khaled bin Talal Al Saud, known as the "Sleeping Prince," passed away after nearly 20 years in a coma following a 2005 car accident. His story became a symbol of unwavering hope and paternal devotion. Funeral prayers will be held in Riyadh, with a three-day mourning period observed by family and members of the royal community.

item.title: 'Biglaw biter': Sidley Austin fires summer intern who started biting co-workers, HR representative
item.description: Sidley Austin, a global law firm, terminated a summer intern in its Manhattan office as she reportedly started biting people. The bizarre incident is now a hot topic on Reddit. Reports suggest multiple individuals were bitten, including interns and lawyers. Some claim the intern also ordered an expensive wine during a dinner which was mentioned in her termination meeting.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: RTA extends Dubai Metro timings for Global Encounters Festival: Rules, timing, full travel details here
item.description: Dubai’s Roads and Transport Authority (RTA) has extended Dubai Metro hours to 1am on Sunday, July 20, to support crowds attending the Global Encounters Festival at Dubai World Trade Centre. The one-week festival celebrates art, culture, and sports within the Ismaili Muslim community. Attendees are urged to use public transport due to expected traffic and limited parking.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: UAE: Sharjah’s Khorfakkan mountain road to become the next big winter tourism destination!
item.description: Sharjah is building a new mountain road to Khorfakkan’s highest peak, reaching 1,100 metres above sea level. Designed for tourism, the route will feature trees, water canals, and hillside homes. With cooler winter weather and scenic views, the project aims to turn the area into a major seasonal destination, while also supporting nearby mountain villages.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: 'Exploited patients for sex': Indian-origin doctor in New Jersey charged with medical fraud, assault on female patients
item.description: Ritesh Kalra, a New Jersey doctor, faces charges of medical fraud as he allegedly distributed opioids without medical need. Kalra is also accused of billing for fake visits. Exploiting his position as a physician, Dr Kalra solicited sexual favors for prescriptions, as confirmed by his former employees and patients.

item.title: 'Obama can't be jailed as that might cause civil unrest': Major outrage over Tulsi Gabbard's claim amid Epstein blowback
item.description: Tulsi Gabbard accused Barack Obama of orchestrating fake intelligence related to Russian interference in the 2016 election, alleging an attempt at a coup against Trump. Gabbard said she is providing documents to the DOJ, including intelligence assessments and memos from officials like James Clapper and John Brennan. GOP erupted seeking action against Obama.
